title: BeforeModel output
description: Adjusts this request only; Zed history is never changed. No deny: a hook never cuts the model. Exit code 2 or a `decision` field is a non-blocking failure, logged with its reason; the request is sent. Closed: this event has no Claude Code counterpart to stay compatible with.

systemMessage.description: Warning shown to the user as a Zed notification (one per event, cut at 2000 characters), only when the output is accepted; never sent to the model.

hookEventName.description: Must be this event name; a mismatch is a hook failure.

max_output_tokens.description: Lowers the output ceiling of this request. A value above the current one is ignored.

remove_tools.description: Zed extension. Names of tools removed from the tool list of THIS request only: the model does not see them. A name absent from the request is ignored and logged. Generic: Zed knows nothing of why (a profile, a guard). Several hooks: the union of their lists. Ignored for the compaction request (is_compaction true). Removing a tool from the list does not refuse a call to it: a guard that must forbid a tool still denies it in PreToolUse.

items.description: Name of one tool, as sent to the model.

remove_skills.description: Zed extension. Names of skills removed from the <available_skills> catalogue of the system message of THIS request only (crates/agent/src/templates/system_prompt.hbs:231-239): each <skill> entry whose <name> is listed is dropped. A name absent from the catalogue is ignored and logged. If every entry is removed, the block stays, empty; a hook that wants no skill at all also removes the skill tool with remove_tools. Generic: Zed knows nothing of why. Several hooks: the union of their lists. Ignored for the compaction request (is_compaction true). Hiding a skill does not refuse it: a guard still denies it in PreToolUse.

items.description: Name of one skill, as written in its <name> entry.

tool_result_replacements.description: Tool results to replace in this request only (for example a shortened result with a note).

tool_use_id.description: Id of the tool call whose result is replaced.

text.description: Replacement text, including the note for the model.

system_prompt_insert.description: Text inserted into the system message of THIS request only, right before the `## System Information` heading of the Zed template (crates/agent/src/templates/system_prompt.hbs:144); if that heading is not found, at the end of the system message, and Zed writes a log line. Several hooks: texts are joined in declaration order (chain rule), separated by a blank line. The hook MUST return the same text from one request to the next while its inputs do not change: the server reuses the cached prompt prefix, and a text that changes (time, counter, random order) invalidates that cache on every request. Ignored for the compaction request (is_compaction true). At most 10000 characters for the JOINED text of all hooks of one request, the cap Claude Code puts on additionalContext (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1054): the text is resent with every request and counts in the context window. Beyond it, the inserts of the following hooks are ignored and logged.

ephemeral_messages.description: Zed extension. Texts that Zed appends at the LAST position of THIS request, each wrapped in <system-reminder> ... </system-reminder>, the wrapper Claude Code uses for hook context (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1117). Role user (role system at the end is refused by vLLM, measured 30/10). The OpenAI-compatible conversion of Zed merges consecutive user messages (crates/open_ai/src/completion.rs:712-725 at zed@422b53c): when the request ends with the user message, each reminder becomes a content part of THAT message; after tool results, the first reminder opens a user message and the next ones are its parts. The reminders stay last either way. Escaping: any <system-reminder or </system-reminder prefix in the text, case-insensitive and tolerant of spaces inside the tag, without requiring the closing >, has its < replaced by < before wrapping. Stricter than Claude Code, which documents the exact tags (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1140). Never kept in the conversation: the next request no longer contains them. Several hooks: chained in declaration order. At most 10000 characters of raw reminder text per request, counted before escaping and wrapping; beyond, the reminders of the following hooks are ignored and logged. Ignored for the compaction request, the panel summary and the conversation title (thread_summarization). Zed calls BeforeModel again on each retry of the same request: a one-shot reminder must clear its state in AfterModel, after the response, not in BeforeModel.

items.description: Raw text of one reminder, without the wrapper (Zed adds it).
